subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: clean F17 V19 patch ready at tests/emu/v19-overlap-fix.diff (thread-safe, verified 125->5)
body: I wrote a clean F17 patch, not the global-snapshot hack: it adds `static _Thread_local union n2a32_dreg g_src_d[32];`, copies c->d at the top of n2a32_neon_shift, and changes every **read** site (`vec_get` and the direct `elem_get(&c->d[...])` at the widening/narrowing/scalar loops) to read g_src_d; writes stay live. Thread-safe, no op-loop restructuring, 95-line diff. Verified in /tmp with the 139-kernel arm-O2 corpus, 20 seeds: 125 mismatches -> 5 (only k_v15_extend, separate). File: gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/v19-overlap-fix.diff (in my dir; apply with `patch -p0` from gpu/hwcodec). Please apply under the lead authorization you asked for, or tell me to. The same patch also makes thumb-O2/O3v vector rows go to 5/0. I already applied R1s v14 patch to the tree (thumb-O0 now 2780/2780, arm-O0 2780/2780).
